title: Grohnpetrel
description: Grohnpetrel is a fictional coastal conservation and seabird education project by Constructor University students in Bremen. Learn why seabirds need help.

title: What is Grohnpetrel?
description: What is Grohnpetrel? A fictional coastal conservation and seabird education initiative from Bremen-Grohn, named after the petrel seabird.

title: The Grohnpetrel Mission
description: The Grohnpetrel mission: make coastal and seabird conservation education accessible to young people through guides, awareness and community action.

title: Seabird Conservation: Threats and Challenges
description: The main threats to seabirds: plastic pollution, accidental fishing, habitat loss, oil spills, climate change and invasive predators, explained.

title: Take Action: How to Help Protect Seabirds
description: Simple ways to help protect seabirds: reduce plastic waste, respect nesting areas, don't feed wild seabirds, and support groups like BirdLife and NABU.

title: Grohnpetrel Programmes
description: Three proposed Grohnpetrel education programmes, Coastal Classroom, Citizen Observation and Responsible Coast, and how we would measure success.

title: Grohnpetrel Knowledge Centre
description: The Grohnpetrel Knowledge Centre: guides on seabirds, coastal ecosystems and the threats they face, for students and anyone curious about nature.

title: Grohnpetrel FAQ
description: Grohnpetrel FAQ: what Grohnpetrel is, whether it is a real bird, where the name comes from, who created it, and why it takes no donations.

title: About Grohnpetrel and the Guillemots Team
description: Who made Grohnpetrel: the Guillemots, four students at Constructor University in Bremen. Team, roles, why we chose the concept and how we used AI.

title: Contact the Grohnpetrel Team
description: How to contact the Guillemots student team behind Grohnpetrel, a fictional coastal-conservation project at Constructor University, Bremen.

title: Imprint

title: Privacy Policy
